_doc: TEMPLATE — copy to <tender_name>.criteria.json and hand-label the GROUND-TRUTH תנאי סף for a real tender. You pay this labeling cost ONCE per document; thereafter every prompt/code change is scored against it (precision/recall/F1) automatically. Run:  python run_poc.py --pdf <pdf> --eval data/golden/<tender_name>.criteria.json

criteria.category: financial | classification | experience | certification | insurance | legal | personnel | other
criteria.field: machine field, e.g. annual_turnover_ils | contractor_classification | similar_public_projects | certifications | insurance_third_party_liability
criteria.value: required value (number, string, or object for classification)
criteria.description_he: תיאור מילולי של תנאי הסף בעברית
